574-730-7084.description:
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Vish Kal's ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Emeria Angel triggers, creating a 1/1 white Bird creature token with flying
Resolve Vish Kal's ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.
574-730-7084.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

4279-6887-7192--216.easyPrerequisites:

4279-6887-7192--216.description:

When the creature dies, Grave Venerations, The Skullspore Nexus and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Grave Venerations trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the The Skullspore Nexus ability, creating a X/X Fungus creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Grave Venerations triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

Repeat.

Resolve Exsanguinate, causing each opponent to lose X life, and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color.

Resolve the Grinding Station ability, causing target player to mill three cards.

Repeat.
If you can produce at least one additional mana in step 4, this combo produces infinite mana.
